author: Russell Brand
description:
Are we witnessing the collapse of humanity from the inside out? Russell Brand and Gabe discuss the simultaneous decline of human well-being and trust in institutions, the promises of transhumanism, and why faith and community may be essential to rebuilding our lives. Russell also opens up about his personal struggles and how turning to Jesus Christ helped him confront despair.

author: Russell Brand
description:
I’m joined by Michael H. Peters to discuss his new book Beyond World Religions and his argument that Christ cannot be contained by institutions, denominations or religious systems. We talk about what it means to be born again, the difference between knowing Christianity as a doctrine and actually living in relationship with God, and whether traces of divine truth can be found across different cultures and religious traditions.

Get Michael H. Peters’ book Beyond World Religions for free: https://beyondworldreligions.com

Later, I catch up with Nicholas, who has been working at the studio and wants to marry his partner Jasmine. We’ve set up a GoFundMe to help them finally make the wedding happen.
